parole.significato: to mock, to scorn, to scoff
parole.testo: The root ק־ל־ס has 3 meanings, "to mock/scorn", "to stomp", and "to laud". The root appears in other Semitic languages as Ugaritic 𐎖𐎍𐎕 (qlṣ /⁠qlṣ⁠/, “to scoff, to mock”), Aramaic קַלֵּס (“to praise, to laud”), Ge'ez ተሳለቀ (täsaläḳä, “to scoff at”), and Arabic قَلَّسَ (qallasa, “to mock, to laud”).
